meta.title: Don't Get Scammed in Vietnam! 🇻🇳 Top 10 Ho Chi Minh City Travel Scams
meta.channel: Pepé Le Pauly — Asia Travel Vlog
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam? In this video, I cover some of the most common tourist scams and situations visitors should be aware of while exploring Saigon. From transportation and taxi scams to overcharging, street scams, tourist traps, theft, and other common travel problems, knowing what to watch for can help you enjoy your trip with greater confidence.

Ho Chi Minh City is an exciting and welcoming destination, but like many major tourist cities, visitors should stay alert and use common sense. This video shares practical Saigon travel tips and safety advice to help travelers avoid unnecessary problems while exploring markets, tourist areas, nightlife districts, and busy streets.
